package.name: flir_frame_publisher
package.description: Publishes FLIR thermal frames (radiometric JPEG / RJPG) from a folder as sensor_msgs/Image (bgr8) so LVT2Calib's cam_pattern node (isRGB=false) can consume them. Sibling of zed_frame_publisher, adapted to RJPG input (embedded colormapped JPEG, or raw 16-bit radiometric via exiftool).
